svg.title: Universal Agent Plugins — 1,500+ plugins and Agent Skills
svg.desc: Install plugins and Skills across AI agents with one command. Supports Agent Plugins 1.0, the Agent Skills standard, Skills and MCP. Apache 2.0 licensed.
